findings: Viewed exactly six listed original normal-game lamp frames. Marrow has warm pale porous cross-sections versus dark red intact skin and blue substrate; pore-bank has purple intact skin and pale porous cut over a warmer open bed. The perforations remain within matter and do not masquerade as floor access.

Severe variants retain cut/skin/floor separation and localized green fracture response; the actual illuminated bottom boundaries are readable. Unlit portions and behind-body areas are not independently approved.
Low versus severe frames preserve morphology without turning the complete object green. Low connection frame is naturally dimmer, and still separates the two banks from the passage.
limitations: Normal material/edge review only. Not a deep severe-pressure journey, performance, audio or all-angle acceptance.
B06 short-fibre and felt remain rejected under P34; these two worlds do not confer whole-batch approval.
